name: Storrow Drive: impassable
quote: In Boston, an underpass of Storrow Drive eastbound had flood waters 3-4 feet deep. A driver was trapped and was rescued. In the Dorchester section of Boston, Morton Street at West Main Street was flooded and impassable.

quote: In Waltham, adjacent to Lexington Street, significant flooding occurred in a parking lot full of unoccupied school buses.  Eight school buses were unable to be moved due to flood waters reaching as high as the engine battery levels.  Broadcast media showed a Twitter photo of this event.
